product.name: Quantix UltraSlide 12-Pos
product.description: Quantix UltraSlide 12-Pos offers a standardized glass slide set designed for routine histology and cytology work. Each slide measures 12 cm by 7.5 cm and is pre‑coated with a thin adhesive layer to secure specimen mounting. The set includes twelve individual slides packaged in a protective plastic sleeve, facilitating easy storage and transport. The clear glass surface provides optimal light transmission for bright‑field microscopy, while the uniform thickness ensures consistent imaging across multiple samples. Ideal for laboratories requiring reliable, high‑quality slides for routine staining, immunohistochemistry, or rapid diagnostic procedures, Quantix UltraSlide delivers durability and precision in a compact, cost‑effective package.
